title: SpaceTraders - Charting
description: Charting as an income line: what the fleet has charted, what it earns per waypoint, which systems are done, and whether the crews are actually being given work.

panels.title: Waypoints Charted
panels.description: Charting rewards booked to the ledger this era. One reward = one waypoint charted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Charted"
  FROM transactions
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
   AND description LIKE 'Charting reward%'

panels.title: Charting Income
panels.description: Total credits earned from charting rewards. This is gross income with no cost of goods - the hull is already paid for.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0)::bigint AS "Credits"
  FROM transactions
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
   AND description LIKE 'Charting reward%'

panels.title: Charts / hour
panels.description: Charting rate over the last complete hour. Partial-hour readings are misleading, so this window is closed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Charts/h"
  FROM transactions
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
   AND description LIKE 'Charting reward%'
   AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

panels.title: Credits / chart
panels.description: Mean reward per waypoint over the last hour. Falls as the crews work through the barren tier, which sorts last by design.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(amount)),0)::bigint AS "Per chart"
  FROM transactions
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
   AND description LIKE 'Charting reward%'
   AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

panels.title: Credits / hour
panels.description: Charting income over the last hour. Compare against trade margin to see which line is carrying the era.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0)::bigint AS "Credits/h"
  FROM transactions
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
   AND description LIKE 'Charting reward%'
   AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

panels.title: Charting rate and income (10-minute buckets)
panels.description: Charts and credits per 10 minutes. A falling per-chart value with steady volume is the barren tier being worked, not a fault.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch FROM created_at)/600)*600) AS time,
       COUNT(*)::bigint AS charts,
       SUM(amount)::bigint AS credits
  FROM transactions
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
   AND description LIKE 'Charting reward%'
   AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Crews by system
panels.description: Where the charting hulls actually are. DISPATCHED is in transit; CHARTING is on station and working.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT system_symbol || ' (' || seed_state || ')' AS metric,
       COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
  FROM sensing_seed_hulls
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Coverage - what is left to chart
Waypoints Remaining
panels.description: Uncharted waypoints across every system the sensing ledger knows. Each one is a charting reward we have not collected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Remaining"
  FROM waypoints w
 WHERE w.traits ILIKE '%UNCHARTED%'
   AND w.system_symbol IN (SELECT system_symbol FROM sensing_systems
                            WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players))

panels.title: Coverage
panels.description: Share of known-system waypoints already charted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.traits NOT ILIKE '%UNCHARTED%')
             / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS "Coverage"
  FROM waypoints w
 WHERE w.system_symbol IN (SELECT system_symbol FROM sensing_systems
                            WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players))

panels.title: Income Left On The Table
panels.description: Remaining uncharted waypoints valued at the last hour's mean reward. An estimate, not a promise - reward varies 5k to 214k by waypoint.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
     rate AS (SELECT COALESCE(AVG(amount), 0) AS per_chart
                FROM transactions, me
               WHERE player_id = me.pid
                 AND description LIKE 'Charting reward%'
                 AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'),
     left_over AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
                     FROM waypoints w, me
                    WHERE w.traits ILIKE '%UNCHARTED%'
                      AND w.system_symbol IN (SELECT system_symbol FROM sensing_systems WHERE player_id = me.pid))
SELECT ROUND(rate.per_chart * left_over.n)::bigint AS "Estimated"
  FROM rate, left_over

panels.title: Systems Known
panels.description: Systems in the sensing ledger. The frontier grows only when a hull arrives somewhere new and reads its gate neighbours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Systems"
  FROM sensing_systems
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)

panels.title: Systems With No Crew
panels.description: Known systems holding uncharted work but with no seed hull assigned. These are idle income - the first thing to chase when the rate sags.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
     work AS (SELECT s.system_symbol
                FROM sensing_systems s, me
               WHERE s.player_id = me.pid
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM waypoints w
                              WHERE w.system_symbol = s.system_symbol
                                AND w.traits ILIKE '%UNCHARTED%')),
     crewed AS (SELECT DISTINCT system_symbol FROM sensing_seed_hulls, me WHERE player_id = me.pid)
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Uncrewed"
  FROM work WHERE system_symbol NOT IN (SELECT system_symbol FROM crewed)

panels.title: Per-system charting progress
panels.description: Every known system: how far charted, how much is left, and whether a crew is on it. Sorted by remaining work, so the biggest untapped systems sit at the top.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
     wp AS (SELECT w.system_symbol,
                   COUNT(*) AS total,
                   COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.traits ILIKE '%UNCHARTED%') AS remaining
              FROM waypoints w
             GROUP BY 1),
     crew AS (SELECT system_symbol, COUNT(*) AS hulls
                FROM sensing_seed_hulls, me
               WHERE player_id = me.pid
               GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.system_symbol            AS "System",
       s.verdict                  AS "Verdict",
       COALESCE(s.seed_state,'-') AS "Seed",
       COALESCE(c.hulls,0)::bigint AS "Crew",
       COALESCE(wp.total,0)::bigint AS "Waypoints",
       COALESCE(wp.remaining,0)::bigint AS "Remaining",
       COALESCE(ROUND(100.0*(wp.total-wp.remaining)/NULLIF(wp.total,0),1),0) AS "Charted %"
  FROM sensing_systems s
  LEFT JOIN wp     ON wp.system_symbol = s.system_symbol
  LEFT JOIN crew c ON c.system_symbol = s.system_symbol
 WHERE s.player_id = (SELECT pid FROM me)
 ORDER BY "Remaining" DESC

panels.title: Partition health - is the crew being given work
Fleet-partition answers (solved vs fallback)
panels.description: A fallback means the routing service could not solve and the crew was split by angular sector with no balancing - one hull takes nearly everything and the rest idle. This should stay at zero.

panels.title: Stored partitions - stops per hull
panels.description: The live partition each crew is flying. Balance is by tour TIME, not stop count, so an uneven count is not itself a fault - but a hull with zero stops is idle, and one hull holding nearly every stop is the signature of a failed solve.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT system_symbol AS "System",
       COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Hulls",
       SUM(json_array_length(waypoints::json))::bigint AS "Stops",
       MAX(json_array_length(waypoints::json))::bigint AS "Max stops",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE json_array_length(waypoints::json) = 0)::bigint AS "Idle hulls",
       MAX(updated_at) AS "Solved"
  FROM sensing_chart_shares
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 4 DESC

options.content:
**Charting is gross income.** Every waypoint pays a reward regardless of type, so the barren tier is worth charting even though it holds no markets. `ChartPriority` still visits market- and shipyard-bearing types first, which is why credits-per-chart falls as a system nears completion - that is the design working, not a fault.

**Crew size is decided by the walk, not by the cap.** A crew of `c` clears the outstanding count in `2*outstanding/c` turns while the c-th hull pays two turns per gate hop plus its arrival sweep; a hull is worth adding while `outstanding/c` covers that walk plus a half. `chart_hull_cap` (15) only bounds what the walk may buy.

**Two things to chase when the rate sags:** systems with uncharted work and no crew, and a non-zero fallback count. A fallback means the partition was cut by angular sector with no balancing, so most of the crew idles while one hull carries the system.

**Not shown, because it is not instrumented:** per-hull charts completed, time from seed dispatch to first chart, and whether a stored partition is stale relative to the live crew.
